The ratified RESO Web API Core requires OAuth2 Bearer Token or Client Credentials authentication: https://transport.reso.org/proposals/web-api-core/. example: corrected because a Bearer value is an OAuth access token, not an API key; RESO's current reference-server guide demonstrates Authorization: Bearer and Property queries: https://tools.reso.org/guides/reso-reference-server/.
